heading: ITR Portal MSP Penalised: What It Means for Your Filing
tldr: The government has penalised the managed service provider (MSP) of the Income Tax e-filing portal for technical issues.
These issues had previously led to extensions in the Income Tax Return (ITR) filing deadlines.
The penalty, imposed in FY2025-26, signals the government's expectation of robust portal performance.
This action suggests that taxpayers should not anticipate further ITR deadline extensions due to technical glitches.
Ensuring timely ITR filing is now more critical than ever to avoid penalties and complications.
caption:
Ever wondered if ITR filing deadlines will be extended again? Here's some news that might clear things up. The government has penalised the company managing the Income Tax portal for past technical issues. This means they expect the portal to work smoothly now. So, don't count on extensions due to glitches anymore. It's more important than ever to file your taxes on time! Read more about what this means for you.
